title: Full dynamic response-space coupling under standard DBD versus no-under-relaxation

comparison.interpretation: NOUR removes the strict DBD path-memory mechanism identified in G21D but does not reproduce the full G17 accepted trajectory. It converges to an endpoint essentially identical to G17, but with more safeguard contractions, more SWAP diagnostic work and seven more MODFLOW solve calls than STANDARD in this frozen case.

bounded_conclusions: The archived G21 STANDARD path effect is reproduced exactly, so the solver-configuration comparison is causally anchored.
STANDARD DBD and NOUR both converge to physically reference-qualified coupled endpoints under the unchanged dynamic response-space algorithm.

STANDARD retains the strict G21 trajectory divergence but still closes the external coupling residual at 2.95e-16 m/s and ends only 1.28e-10 m from the independent G17 endpoint, within the preregistered 5e-10 endpoint guard.

NOUR ends approximately 1.67e-15 m from the G17 endpoint with an external residual near 6.91e-21 m/s, but it does not recover the G17 accepted trajectory: its second and third accepted updates differ by several micrometres and require additional safeguard contractions.

In this frozen case STANDARD is cheaper: 17 MODFLOW solve calls, 3 accepted updates, 2 contractions and 34 physical SWAP diagnostic trials versus 24 calls, 5 updates, 7 contractions and 63 physical SWAP diagnostic trials for NOUR.

G21D remains valid mechanistic evidence that delta-bar-delta carries the strict prepared-solve path memory. G21E shows that removing that memory is not equivalent to recovering the reference coupling trajectory and does not automatically improve coupling efficiency.
The strict G21 path-equivalence falsification and physical endpoint convergence are distinct statements. The former remains falsified for STANDARD; the latter is supported in this frozen case.
No production IMS configuration, E3/P4/response-space policy, HCOF/RHS semantics or timestep publication rule is admitted or changed.
next_natural_unit: Broaden the matched STANDARD-versus-NOUR comparison beyond the single frozen G11 stress before any solver-configuration conclusion: select preregistered regimes that vary storage strength, forcing, active process/execution class and safeguard activation, and compare physical convergence, mass/transaction authority, cost and path sensitivity. Keep production IMS defaults unchanged.
